posts.name: Koga
posts.cooked:
Made similar post on BGG when the forum was down but figured I’d post here too.

I noticed that on the back of the new Wraith card she has 4 figures in the shadows, the first one is Spite, the others look similar to Two-face, Penguin, and possibly Catwoman. Will we ever see a Hero have more than one Nemesis? If the expansions continue in the trend Rook City is going then the Villians will outnumber the Heroes on the 4th expansion. Can easily give a Hero more than one Villian as their Nemesis and not change the game mechanics. This as well would give us more options to choose from when we want use a Hero to fight their Nemesis.
